implementation: Each transcript turn shows its exact source interval in milliseconds and channel number when available.
When channel metadata is absent, the UI explicitly displays Channel unknown.
Audio navigation passes the original channel when available and the source interval start time.
limitations: No browser interaction test specifically asserts the channel label.
No channel is inferred when source metadata is absent; channel-first diarization remains unavailable without established hardware/input channel semantics.
This build evidence does not establish clinical usability or real-hardware behavior.
